BUT the `tl.pause(gateT)` half of the stall fix introduced THREE new defects inside this scope, all measured live and all now pinned in place by the new source asserts: (a) BLOCKER — `skip()`'s `entrance.timeScale(1).progress(1)` does NOT suppress events (the source comment claiming it does is wrong; only `seek()` defaults suppressEvents true), so while the readiness gate is armed the gate callback fires mid-jump and `pause(gateT)` ABORTS the jump: the entrance ends parked at 1.65 with done=true and the cover permanently blank — no lantern, no goblin, no brand, no tagline, no scroll hint (walks/p5/p5-verify-blocker-skip-blank-at-readiness-gate-1568x602.jpg; reproduced with wheel and with keydown on plain cold dev loads and deterministically with a never-resolving `document.fonts.ready`; A/B: the identical `progress(1)` jump with the gate unarmed lands exactly on the settled fingerprint; in-page gsap 3.15.0 probe: seek-in-callback ends at time 1.65 prog 0.647 with the post-gate beat unrendered, bare `pause()` completes to prog 1). (b) BLOCKER — the PRM branch's `entrance.progress(1, true)` suppresses `onUpdate: applyStrokes`, so a cold load under prefers-reduced-motion settles with `rig.birth` 0 and 158 of 193 stroke meshes at instanceCount 0: the entire underdrawing and every ink contour are missing (walks/p5/p5-verify-blocker-prm-coldload-no-underdrawing-1568x602.jpg). (c) MAJOR — the `ENTRANCE.strokes.max` 4s stall cap is now dead: restore() plays, the gate re-fires and re-pauses at 1.65 forever (measured 16s parked, done=false, with clearStall() having already removed the "sharpening pencils…" note), so the entrance waits on fonts indefinitely instead of capping at 4s. One latch fixes all three: fire the gate once (`let gated = false`) and keep `progress(1)` events ON in both the skip and PRM paths. **ALL THREE FIXED and independently walked (P5b verify, 2026-09-03, 1906×732 / captures 1568×602 — walks/p5/p5b-verify-walk-log.md).** The fix is the latch PLUS an ordering: `skip()` now runs `finishEntrance()` FIRST and then an events-ON `entrance.timeScale(1).progress(1)`, and the PRM branch does the same — the latch alone is not enough, because input arriving BEFORE the gate's first fire lets the gate consume the latch inside the jump and abort it at 1.65 (proved by negative test N3 below). (a) armed gate `{t:1.65, prog:0.516, ts:0.18, seam:−3.4, glow:0, gob:false, flame:false, brand:0, wm/tag inset 100%}` → keydown → the full settled fingerprint (seam 1, birth 1, shadow 0.45, glow 1, gob true, glass f7edcd, flame true, brand 1, wm/tag inset 0%, meta 1, hint 1, 187 strokes full / 0 undrawn), byte-identical again 900 ms later — no re-park, no rewind. (b) PRM cold load with the force in place before mount: `{prm:true, prmFade:true}` and the underdrawing IS there — birth 1, 187 full, 0 at instanceCount 0 (the blocker measured birth 0 / 158 undrawn); the PRM handoff steps to black at ht 2.31 blackout 1 and restores on the way back. (c) the 4 s cap is alive: hands off under `?stallfonts=1` the entrance parks at 1.65 for ~3.5 s, pencils the `sharpening pencils…` margin note on (0 → 0.16 → 0.71 → 0.98 → 1, no spinner), the cap restores it playing at t 1.65 → 1.767 with the note fading 0.17 → 0, and it completes at t 3.2 ≈ 5.3 s into the sampled window — beats at authored pace (glow 0.70 at seam −3.13, 0.99 at −1.18, 1.00 at 0.03). Ignite-before-bloom re-measured on a clean cold load: first glow > 0 at t 1.666 with seam still −3.4, first seam movement at 1.758 with glow already 0.669. A pure ratio test (mark/ref > 1.10) blew up to 10-25x at dozens of points; switching to an absolute screen-pixel margin (over > 3px, roughly one stroke-width per hero.ts's own 2.1px 'form' weight law) still flagged 39 of 63 sampled points, all on the ARC family, never the zigzag. Root cause: `pineSilR` models the whole-tree TAPERED CONE silhouette (correct reference for the zigzag, which literally traces it), but the arc's own `ry = r*0.3` y-radius is DELIBERATELY generous — it dips below a tier's strict cone edge to hug the skirt as a scalloped ellipse (row 5's own accepted, hero-verified construction) — so measuring an arc against the linear-taper reference always overshoots near a tier's lower rim, worst where the taper reference approaches its floor (`rWide*0.045`) and any real deviation reads as a huge multiple. Direct visual check settles it: `w1-verify-04-t54.5-S6-prep-montage-basis.png`, read at full res, shows the sapling's strokes entirely inside its drawn cone silhouette — no stroke reaches the paper. The builder's 14->16 and this script's 39/63 are both artefacts of comparing an arc to the wrong reference function; the correct reference for an arc is its own tier's radius (which it is built from directly), not the whole-tree taper. No fix needed on `pineCrown`/`pineZig`; a future off-mass script should family-split its reference (zigzag -> `pineSilR`, arc -> its own tier `r`). | whoever next writes an automated off-mass check for foliage marks — split the reference function per stroke family | tracked |
